name: Alexa's Wild Night
source:
Alexa is just another woman in town, living her life, or is her life living her. But with her birthday rolling up maybe it is time for Alexa to finally cut loose in this visual novel with multiple routes and endings to explore.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/457370/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
亚历克斯只是城里的另一个女人，过着她的生活，或者说她的生活在过着她的生活。但随着她生日的临近，也许Alexa终于可以在这部视觉小说中摆脱束缚，探索多种路线和结局了。

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/457370/]Steam[/url]]
